stage_maturity.0: Pre-product, no funded engineering org, OR fully self-sufficient enterprise
stage_maturity.3: Pre-Series B with engineering still consolidating; OR mature steady-state without acute pressure
stage_maturity.7: Series A or mature steady-state with documented capacity gaps
stage_maturity.10: Series B–D growth, limited internal capacity, active investment + roadmap commitments

company_type.0: Pure hardware OR IT-led (no engineering org owning product software)
company_type.3: Software-integrated / embedded device companies (hardware-led with significant software layer)
company_type.7: Software-Dependent — mission-critical custom software as core function (e.g., Merck, regulated industries)

geography.0: Non-network, non-English-speaking, or jurisdictionally hard market
geography.3: English-speaking market outside network reach (AU, NZ, Singapore, UK)

activation_state.Accelerating: Raising capital, scaling team, public roadmap commitments, new capability hires
activation_state.Transitioning: Re-platforming, post-funding inflection, new CTO/VP Eng, restructuring engineering
activation_state.Contracting: Layoffs, hiring freeze, cost-cutting, declining metrics — requires dated evidence ≤ 12 months

buying_signal.0: No detectable buying signal in the current window
buying_signal.3: Weak / single-source signal (one posting, generic engineering hire)
buying_signal.7: Single strong signal: high-quality posting cluster, recent funding, or named champion connection
buying_signal.10: Compound signal: concentrated postings (Head of X + 5+ roles) AND funding event OR exec change AND tech-stack investment

activity_no_website: Skipped: organization has no Website URL — fill it and re-create the deal or re-run
